voice_id.description: Pick the voice that fits what the user described — their own words about the speaker, the language, the mood, the medium — from creative_list_voices. When they gave no hint at all, still pick one: a clear, natural, general-purpose voice. Do not ask them to choose first; the result renders with a voice switcher they can use to change it, and each change keeps the earlier takes. A voice_id only ever comes from creative_list_voices or the user — never from memory or invention.

view_state_id.description: Set by the speech view when the user switches voice — never set this yourself. It files the new generation into that view as another take, next to the ones already there. An id that is not a speech view of this workspace simply starts a fresh one.

flow_id.description: The flow to act on, as returned by creative_create_flow or creative_generate_in_flow. Omit it for a one-off generation and a new flow is created. Always pass it when this generation will be combined with another: nodes on different flows cannot be connected, so allocate one with creative_create_flow up front and reuse it.

model_id.description: The model to generate with. Use eleven_multilingual_v2 unless the user asks for something specific. Go looking for a different one when the request implies something the default may not do — a specific resolution or aspect, rendered text, a long duration, a named style or a named provider. creative_get_flow_node_types lists what this workspace can actually run; creative_get_model_guide explains how to prompt one. Pick by what the request needs: eleven_v3 for inline audio direction tags such as [whispering] or [laughs softly].

generations_count.description: How many variations to produce, so the user can pick. Defaults to 4 so the user can pick from several options — keep it at 4 unless the user asks for a specific number. Costs scale with the count.

estimate_only.description: Return the credit cost and any blocking node errors without generating anything. Worth doing before a long video or several variations, so the user can approve the spend first.

Always pass it when this generation will be combined with another: nodes on different flows cannot be connected, so allocate one with creative_create_flow up front and reuse it.

session_ids.description: The session_ids returned when the run started. A run of several variations reports one session per variation; pass them all so the status covers the whole run.

search.description: Optional search over voice names and descriptions.

context.description: Why are you calling this tool? Briefly describe the user's goal.

voice_description.description: What the voice should sound like — age, accent, tone, pacing, emotion. From the user's own words, never invented.

text.description: The line the previews will speak. Obtained from the user, never invented or auto-generated — this is what they will judge the voice by.

language.description: ISO language code for text. From the user, never guessed from voice_description alone.

model_id.description: The voice design model. Use eleven_ttv_v3 unless the user asks for the older multilingual model.

guidance_scale.description: How closely the previews follow voice_description versus sounding natural. Higher follows the description more strictly.

seed.description: Fixes the randomness so a repeat call reproduces the same previews. Omit for a fresh set each time.

quality.description: Higher quality gives a better voice but less variety. Only accepted with eleven_multilingual_ttv_v2; passing it with eleven_ttv_v3 is rejected.

should_enhance.description: Whether to enhance the generated previews. Leave at the default unless the user asks otherwise.

view_state_id.description: Set by the voice-design view when the user edits the line and hits Regenerate — never set this yourself. It replaces that view's previews with the new round instead of minting a separate view. Regenerating still spends credits like any other call to this tool: if you genuinely want another round, call this tool again with no view_state_id rather than passing this.

context.description: Why are you calling this tool? Briefly describe the user's goal.

generated_voice_id.description: The preview to keep, from creative_design_voice's previews[].generated_voice_id — never invented.

name.description: Display name for the new voice in the workspace's library.

description.description: Description shown alongside the voice in the library.

labels.description: Optional labels (e.g. accent, gender, age) stored with the voice; string values only. Max 20 entries, keys <=20 chars, values <=50 chars.

discarded_voice_ids.description: generated_voice_ids of the other previews the user did not pick, from the same creative_design_voice call.

view_state_id.description: The id of the voice-design view this save belongs to, as returned by creative_design_voice — never set this yourself. Refuses the call rather than saving a second voice if this view already saved one.
